# Inquiry Publishing Stack — Vault Interface entrypoint

Current component: Vault Interface
Role: provider-neutral public metadata contract. This repository is not a private vault or private control plane.

Default full-stack adoption:
full AHICP + full PPF + Vault Interface + project-owned content.

Privacy boundary:
Vault Interface exposes only approved public metadata. Original or unpublished project source remains private by default. Continuous Web may be prepared as restricted/authenticated until explicit human public-release authorization. Public links never authorize private-state retrieval.

Agent instruction:
Reconstruct the four-component ecosystem before cross-component configuration. For Cloudflare work, follow the shared operational contract and relevant PPF provider runbooks; when human UI action is required, give numbered operator steps, secret boundaries, completion evidence, verification, and rollback.
